description: This walk follows a section of the Ceredigion Coast Path from Aberystwyth to Aberaeron. The route runs for just over 16 miles passing the Pen Dinas Hillfort and the Penderi Cliffs Nature Reserve near Llanrhystud. The reserve includes some fine cliff top views, Sessile Oak woodlands and a wide variety of interesting flora and fauna. Look out for birds including Chough, Buzzard, Kestrel, Peregrine and Fulmar as you make your way through this lovely area.Along the way there's fine views over Cardigan Bay where you can see bottlenose dolphins and grey seals.
